name: YMCA Camp Mohawk
description_short: A YMCA camp for girls in Litchfield, CT, on its own pond. Overnight camp runs in two-week sessions for ages 7-15 and one-week sessions mostly for ages 7-11; there is also a weekly day camp for ages 5-12 and a four-week Counselor in Training program for ages 16-17. Horseback riding lessons can be added for an extra fee.
refund_policy_summary: Overnight camp: a $300 deposit per session is not refundable; cancellations in writing before April 1 get all other fees back, and there are no refunds after April 1 or once camp has started. Day camp: an $80 deposit per week is not refundable; cancellations before June 1 get all other fees back, none after. Deposits move with the camper if she switches to a session with space.

warnings: Mixed programs: overnight camp (main program, listed as sleepaway), a day camp for ages 5-12, and a CIT program. price_per_week ($483) is the day camp weekly rate. Overnight sessions cost $1,646 for one week and $3,039 for two weeks.
Day camp text says balances are due 'April 1, 2026', which is likely a typo for 2027. The overnight text says April 1, 2027.
Waitlist text ('eligible for Priority Enrollment for summer 2027 ... enroll for 2027 before it opens to the public') looks left over from last season.
Availability percentages (e.g. ~95% Full) can change quickly.
No changeover between Sessions 4 and 5. Families booking several sessions should contact the camp about changeover.
Horseback riding lessons cost extra: $270 for one week, $540 for two weeks.
Locations: Litchfield, CT comes from a P.O. box mailing address and may not be where the camp is.

swim_waterfront_notes: Waterfront activities are on Mohawk Pond, which camp has to itself: instructional and free swimming, canoeing, kayaking, rowing, sailing, windsurfing, paddleboarding and log rolling. Day campers have a daily free swim and waterfront period.
